original_test_intent: Read one explicitly authorized active Redfish Session resource, validate exact resource identity and permitted user/origin metadata, and preserve a redacted result without refreshing, deleting or otherwise altering the session.
original_method: Resolve `session_id` from an approved collection snapshot, issue one trusted GET to that exact member, validate Session schema/@odata identity and export only owner-approved redacted fields.
manual_activity: The security/BMC owner authorizes the exact session member from a captured collection, approves access to UserName/origin metadata, and defines pseudonymization/redaction for identifiers, addresses and any OEM fields.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Authorized session member link from a timestamped collection
Privacy/redaction policy for username, origin address and identifiers
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials, tokens or Authorization
Do not guess or enumerate IDs
No DELETE/PATCH/session creation or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Select one authorized link from the approved collection snapshot
Handle a legitimate expired-session response without retrying another ID
Export approved redacted fields and no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Authorize the exact session and privacy scope
Interpret session-expiry evidence and own final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The member path and explicit SESSION_ID requirement fit the source, but `-k`, basic-auth argv and direct username/IP output are unsafe; it lacks exact link/schema checks and secret-field rejection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, GET exactly one owner-authorized session link from the captured collection, validate exact @odata.id/Session schema, reject secret fields and export only pseudonymized approved metadata.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The one-member GET and 15/10 timing remain; no ID, username, origin or expected lifetime is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the member read to an authorized timestamped collection link, validate identity/schema in one request, distinguish legitimate expiration from identity mismatch and produce privacy-safe evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authorization provenance, trusted transport, ephemeral-resource handling and field-level privacy controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The collection proves the link existed at its snapshot time; this case validates one member if still active and does not prove collection completeness or session lifecycle operations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A session may expire before the GET; that 404/410-like outcome must be recorded against the captured link rather than triggering enumeration or a different-session retry. Usernames and client IPs remain personal/security data.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK/session token is equivalent only if it does not expose the authentication token, preserves the exact authorized link/certificate binding, validates the Session schema and applies the approved pseudonymization.
expected_evidence: Timestamped authorized collection link and approval
Credential-provider and schema/parser versions without secrets
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw response hash
Exact Session @odata.id/schema or explicit expired-link result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, placeholder, source path and DeepSeek command consistently describe one Session member GET. Missing authorization/redaction and weak criteria do not create a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The resource and operation are explicit. Exact member authorization, trust, credential, schema and privacy policy are concrete prerequisites; a naturally expired member is an evidence outcome, not a reason to guess another ID.

review_improvement: Binds the transient session ID to an authorized snapshot and adds exact identity, expiry-aware and privacy-safe evidence requirements.
independent_technical_reasoning: A session ID selected from a collection is only valid for the lifetime of that active context. The member GET must therefore retain the selected link and collection timestamp; if the session has expired, switching to another ID would change the subject and violate authorization. Exact @odata.id/schema validation prevents cross-resource confusion, while redaction must cover username, origin address, identifier and any accidentally returned authentication material.
